subject: Request: short-term sandbox stipend while PO completes
messages:
From: Anna Calder <anna@veridianhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-29T08:13:00-07:00
Subject: Trial top-up while PO is routing

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Veridian is excited by the latency numbers and the cost projections, but procurement is taking longer than expected to cut a PO. We have a cross-functional review scheduled for next Wednesday, and the vendor onboarding team asked for the PO to be in place before then.

Our engineering and product teams need to keep the sandbox live so they can finish the integration tests (particularly the batching flows). Is there any short-term option for a small credit or voucher to avoid losing momentum? We expect the PO to clear in ~7 calendar days.

If useful, I can loop in our procurement contact (procurement@veridianhealth.com). Appreciate any help — this is a high-priority evaluation for us.

Best,
Anna
Anna Calder
Director, Integrations
Veridian Health

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Calder <anna@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial top-up while PO is routing

Hi Anna — thanks for the note and for the clear timeline. I’m sorry procurement is slowing things down but happy to help keep the sandbox available. A couple quick points: 

- We can provision a short-term sandbox stipend while the PO completes. For an integration test workload like you described the usual option is a 7-day $300 credit or a 3-day $150 bridge — whichever minimizes risk for your team.
- We’ll need an explicit confirmation from your procurement contact that PO submission is in progress (an email is fine).
- I’ll route this to my manager for approval and will follow up within the hour.

If you confirm the prefered length (3 or 7 days) and paste in the procurement contact, I’ll get the internal signoff.

Quick note: I attached a short usage snapshot we captured from your sandbox yesterday to show typical token spend at current test cadence.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
p: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: sandbox-usage-summary-20270528.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Trial top-up while PO is routing — request for short-term stipend

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Looping you in. Veridian (VD-8421) is asking for a short sandbox stipend while procurement finalizes the PO. Details: 7-day $300 credit or 3-day $150 credit. They expect PO to land next week; attached is the usage snapshot showing current test consumption (~12k tokens/day at peak).

Why I recommend the 7-day option: gives the product team enough runway to finish integration and preserves momentum. Risk is low — we would treat this as a one-off courtesy tied to a signed PO within 14 days.

If you’re comfortable with that approach I can confirm with Anna and capture the procurement contact for records. I’ve put a small note you can use for audit: 

"Provisioned 7-day trial stipend ($300) to support customer evaluation due to PO routing delay; to be reconciled against signed PO for VD-8421."

Thoughts?

Thanks,
Priyom

Attachment: approval-note.txt (txt)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial top-up while PO is routing — request for short-term stipend

Priyom / Marissa — approved.

Authorize the 7-day sandbox stipend for Veridian (VD-8421) in the amount of $300. Please:
- Confirm procurement contact and that PO is in-flight; capture their acknowledgement email.
- Enter the credit as "Eval Stipend — PO Pending" on the deal record (HubSpot link below).
- If PO is not signed within 14 days, close the stipend as "expired" and notify finance to reconcile.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8421

Priyom — you can confirm with Anna now. I’ll cc Finance if we need ledger reconciliation.

Ben Carter
